description:
The spiritual glue that holds Dazzling Pearl together.
She dotes on the forgetful Tia much like a older sister does to ensure that she remembers things.
Appears mature on a regular basis, but if an accessory catches her eye, she often indulges in impulse purchases and overspending.

lines.text:
You think studying is all there is to being a student?
Oh, you have much to learn.
Oh my, it's the day the accessory store is having a sale!
I can't believe exams are already here. I hate this.

You're way different from the other teachers.
You treat us like actual students.

Sorry if Tia is getting on your nerves, Teacher.
You're such a good person.
Whenever I get tired of school, can I come and see you? I can keep it a secret.
Hmm... I should do some more studying on my own.

Are you busy?
There's something I'd like you to teach me.

Tia forgot her bag this morning.
I've got to head to the school and pass it to her.
Teacher! A bunch of new accessories just came out at the shopping mall. Come with me to check them out.
I wish the school was this peaceful every day.
I can't wait to be in a graduating class together with you, Teacher. Hehe!
Will you be giving us battle lessons in the future, too?
It's much more efficient when you teach us. Way better than school lessons.
I never thought I'd be able to make it this far. It's all thanks to you, Teacher.
Is it okay for teachers to give presents to their students? Haha.

You picked out the exact gift I wanted!
This is perfect, Teacher, thank you!
I'm so happy that you got this for me! I promise I'll get you something one day.
For some reason, I feel so calm whenever I'm with you.
When you're around, I'm not even scared of exams anymore.
Is there any chance I could come and see you privately today?
Teacher, what are we learning today?
Hehe, what's wrong, Teacher?
I'll follow you closely, Teacher.
A good student listens well.
I can't believe I'm already about to graduate.
Don't get yourself hurt, Teacher.
Time to show what a female student is capable of.
This is pretty close to our practice drills.
Just a moment, gotta reload real quick.
This uniform is so comfortable.
I'm already prepared, Teacher.
I want to preserve beautiful memories of my campus life.
Feast your eyes on what a student can do!
Oh my!
Haha.
Well, that was easy.
Ow!
Ugh!
That hurts!
Sorry, Teacher, I was overconfident. I'm gonna take a break.
Whew... That concludes today's lesson!
I hope this is the last festival I attend as a student.

Tia picked this outfit out for me.
It was the only one left! Does it look good on me?

There are so many interesting shops here.
I wonder if there's a place that sells accessories?

Today, I'm going to forget about all my worries and just have fun.
Won't you join me, Teacher? Hehe.

This festival was fun because we could all walk around together.
But next time... can it just be the two of us?

What are you going to do after the festival?
If you don't have any plans, would you like to hang out a little longer with me?
Hmm... Teacher is late. He didn't forget about the festival today, did he?

I wonder when Teacher is going to show up?
I dressed up really nicely today for him.

Festivals are always so much fun.
I was happy to see Tia having a good time as well.
Teacher, let's check out this side too.
Teacher, do you happen to know when the next festival is going to be?
You're gonna keep teaching me all sorts of things this year too, aren't you? Hehe.
Thanks to you, it looks like I'll be able to graduate soon.
You're amazing! I'd love to keep taking lessons from you forever.
I'm growing steadily, all thanks to you. Hehe.
Thank you. I'll repay you with something even bigger next time.

Oh, would you look at that? I got you a gift too.
Looks like we were thinking of each other, huh?

A gift from Teacher at the festival...
I'll treasure it forever.

Thanks to you, I've gained some confidence.
I guess that's why I like you. Hehe.

Festivals are fun,
but I think I like spending time with you even more.

I think I'm starting to see why you're so well-liked, Teacher.
It makes me a bit envious.
Is the festival already over? That's too bad.
Hmm? Did you call me?
I'll follow along!
I trust you, Teacher, so I hope you can keep teaching me lots.
Watch me closely, Teacher.
Don't underestimate me just because I'm a student.
I'm actually good in real-life battles. Hehe.
I'll do it right away.
Reloading.
One step at a time.
Teacher, I have something to say.
Just you wait!
Should I push a little harder?
Where to next?
Easy enough!
Not bad, right? Hehe.
Ow!
Ouch.
Ah!
I won't be able to enjoy the rest of the festival. What a shame.
Class is over! What do you say we go back and enjoy the festival again? Hehe.
